items.exampleEn: Some people worry that too much technology will dehumanize our lives.
items.exampleZh: 有些人擔心過多的科技會讓我們的生活失去人性。

items.exampleEn: The nobleman's old castle is now a hotel.
items.exampleZh: 那位貴族的舊城堡現在是一間飯店。

items.exampleEn: People in the village respected her simple and godly way of life.
items.exampleZh: 村裡的人尊敬她簡樸又虔誠的生活方式。

items.exampleEn: The company wants to industrialize the way it grows vegetables.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司想把種菜的方式工業化。

items.exampleEn: Why are you calling me at this ungodly hour?
items.exampleZh: 你為什麼在這種不像話的時間打電話給我？

items.exampleEn: Scientists found the bones of a prehuman that lived three million years ago.
items.exampleZh: 科學家發現了三百萬年前一種早期人類祖先的骨頭。

items.exampleEn: Preindustrial cities were much smaller and quieter than today's.
items.exampleZh: 工業化以前的城市比現在的城市小得多，也安靜得多。

items.sentenceEn: Most families lived on farms in preindustrial times.
items.sentenceZh: 在工業化以前的時代，大多數家庭都住在農場上。

items.audioEn: My flight leaves at an ungodly hour, so I have to get up at three.
items.audioZh: 我的班機起飛時間早得離譜，所以我得三點起床。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要三點起床？
options: To watch a game at three
To drive a friend to the airport

items.sentenceEn: The region industrialized faster than its neighbors.
items.sentenceZh: 那個地區工業化的速度比鄰近地區快。

items.sentenceEn: A nobleman from the north married the king's youngest daughter.
items.sentenceZh: 一位北方的貴族娶了國王最小的女兒。

items.stemEn: Calling students by numbers instead of their names can ____ them.
items.stemZh: 用號碼而不是名字叫學生，可能會讓他們失去人性。

items.stemEn: My grandfather was very ____ and read the holy book every morning.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺非常虔誠，每天早上都讀聖書。

items.passageEn: Two hundred years ago, our valley was a quiet preindustrial place where most people grew rice and raised pigs. The land belonged to a nobleman, who was known as a godly man and gave food to the poor every winter. Then the country began to industrialize, and large factories appeared along the river. Workers had to start at an ungodly hour and stand at noisy machines for twelve hours a day, and the factories contaminated the river. Some writers at that time said the factories dehumanized people. Today, one of the old factories is a museum. In its basement, visitors can even see stone tools left by prehumans, which were found when the factory was built.
items.passageZh: 兩百年前，我們的山谷是一個寧靜、尚未工業化的地方，大多數人種稻、養豬。這片土地屬於一位貴族，他以虔誠聞名，每年冬天都會送食物給窮人。後來國家開始工業化，河邊出現了大型工廠。工人必須在早得離譜的時間上工，一天站在吵鬧的機器旁十二個小時，工廠也汙染了河水。當時有些作家說，工廠讓人失去了人性。如今，其中一座老工廠成了博物館。在它的地下室，參觀者甚至可以看到早期人類祖先留下的石器，那是蓋工廠時發現的。

questions.questionZh: 那位貴族每年冬天會做什麼？
options: 在河邊蓋了第一座大工廠

questions.questionZh: 在博物館地下室可以看到什麼？

items.promptZh: 那個城市工業化之後，空氣變得很髒。
referenceEn: After the city industrialized, its air became very dirty.
The air in that city became very dirty after it industrialized.
rubricZh: industrialize 的用法，例如 the city industrialized、after it industrialized 等
時態合理（例如 industrialized、became 等）

items.promptZh: 我的鄰居昨晚三更半夜還在彈鋼琴。
referenceEn: My neighbor was playing the piano at an ungodly hour last night.
Last night, my neighbor played the piano until an ungodly hour.
rubricZh: ungodly 常和 hour 連用，表示時間太早或太晚（例如 at an ungodly hour、until an ungodly hour 等）
昨晚的事用過去式或過去進行式（例如 played、was playing 等）
